_comments.mode: synthetic_demo prints an example only; use real after creating and validating real camera calibrations.
_comments.rail_reference_y_m: Height of the track datum in the shared world frame. This setup defines the datum as Y=0.
_comments.threshold_m: Railway threshold: points at or below this height are defects.
_comments.rule: How the threshold is applied to the measured point height.
_comments.calibration_verified: Set true only after validating real calibrations against surveyed points. Demo mode always remains non-valid.
_comments.max_reprojection_error_px: Maximum image reprojection error allowed for a real measurement; 3 px is a provisional setting.
_comments.cameras: Paths to SBL and SLL calibration NPZ files used by main.py.
_comments.camera_mount_approx_m: Estimated camera centers from the supplied drawing. Z assumes 1.625 m from track center to the near wagon side plus the camera-to-side dimension; X=0 is arbitrary.
_comments.camera_mount_approx_m.x_m: Approximate along-track camera location; zero is an arbitrary shared origin.
_comments.camera_mount_approx_m.y_m: Camera height from the track datum, taken approximately from the drawing.
_comments.camera_mount_approx_m.z_m: Approximate lateral location using the stated 1.625 m drawing dimension; sign is positive toward the cameras.
_comments.camera_mount_approx_m.offset_from_wagon_: Camera-to-wagon-side distance shown in the camera placement drawing.
_comments.demo_assumptions: Made-up pinhole camera settings for software demonstration only; these are not measured camera properties.
_comments.demo_assumptions.focal_length_px: Assumed focal length in pixels; actual lens calibration is unknown.
_comments.demo_assumptions.aim_height_y_m: Assumed point both demo cameras look toward; chosen for a runnable example.
_comments.demo_assumptions.distortion_coefficients: Assumes no lens distortion; actual distortion is unknown.
_comments.demo_assumptions.image_paths: Images whose dimensions are used to build the demo camera matrices.
